report: evaluation-target selection decisions for the four repositories without a frozen v0.4 snapshot
method: Each repository was re-queried on 2026-10-31: tag list from git ls-remote, advisory ranges from the OSV API, and NVD CPE matches by version. A repository is selectable only if a stable, non-obsolete release lies inside a published version range and the advisory batch names the fixed release. The openssl tree was then exported and scanned for the selected advisory ids before the selection row was written.

decisions.reason: The OSV crates.io query returns 14 advisory records; every one is fixed by 0.14.12 at the latest (GHSA-f67m-9j94-qv9j / RUSTSEC-2022-0022, introduced 0, fixed 0.14.12), so the newest vulnerable stable release is v0.14.11 (19f38b3e7febadedbfc558d17fa41baff73c6ecc, 2021-07-21). That is 5.28 years before the 2026-10-31 cutoff and over the 4-year release-sanity threshold that rejected the legacy v0.14.2 proposal. No advisory affects any 1.x release: the newest stable tags v1.11.1 and v1.12.0 have no OSV record, and NVD cpe:2.3:a:hyper:hyper matches zero CVEs at 0.14.32, 1.11.1 and 1.12.0.

The OSV NuGet query returns one advisory, GHSA-5crp-9r3c-p9vr (CVE-2024-21907), introduced 0 and fixed 13.0.1. The tag list jumps from 12.0.3 to 13.0.1 with no 13.0.0 tag, so the newest vulnerable stable release is 12.0.3 (7c3d7f8da7e35dde8fa74188b0decff70f8f10e3, 2019-11-09), 6.98 years before the cutoff; the independent selection review already rejected it as obsolete. NVD has no CVE whose CPE matches newtonsoft:json at 12.0.3, 13.0.1 or 13.0.4.

The OSV records for this repository are OSS-Fuzz fuzzer reports only (OSV-2017-59, OSV-2022-409, OSV-2022-425). Each carries a GIT range between develop-branch commits and no version range, no severity and no advisory status, so no stable release can be pre-registered as vulnerable from them. There is no GHSA entry and no NVD CPE record for nlohmann/json: an NVD keyword query returns two unrelated CVEs (Envoy, NanaZip). The newest stable tag v3.12.0 (2025-04-11) is not implicated by any record.
